name: Hornet
note: Bold black-and-yellow geometric two-tone graphics wrapping the forearm, with a black sport grip. Reads like a racing jersey. Look from: Poison VX graphics.

forearm.prompt: The forearm background is black honeycomb carbon (#111111 to #1E1E1E): a grid of small hexagon cells outlined in thin dark gold lines (#6B5A10). Over it, bold racing-jersey graphics in bright yellow (#FFD21A, with a slightly deeper #E8B800 tone): three or four wide yellow bands that run diagonally across the whole panel from lower left to upper right, with sharp angular cut ends and notches, plus a few thin yellow pinstripes parallel to them. Clean, bold, two-tone black and yellow. The two thin strips at the far left are the joint collar: paint them black carbon-fibre weave (#1C1C1C to #3A3A3A) with a thin yellow line (#FFD21A) at their right edge.

butt.prompt: Left thin strip (the ring): flat bright yellow (#FFD83A). The wrap (from the ring to the next zone line): a black textured sport grip of small overlapping diamond-shaped snakeskin scales in neat rows (#0E0E0E to #2A2A2A), the same all over. The butt sleeve (between the two zone lines on the right): glossy black (#111111) with a bold yellow (#FFD21A) chevron, a sharp V pointing to the left made of two thick angular stripes, on the middle row. The very thin strip at the far right: plain black.

shaft_top.prompt: Glossy black (#111111). Near the right edge (where the joint collar is), about the right third of the panel is black honeycomb carbon (#111111 to #1E1E1E, small hexagon cells outlined in thin dark gold #6B5A10) with two or three bold bright yellow (#FFD21A) chevron arrowheads pointing to the left, stacked one after another like racing arrows. From them, long thin sharp yellow spear stripes run to the left along the length and taper to needle points; the left quarter of the panel is plain glossy black with only the thin needle tips of the yellow stripes.

Trail.Note: The white wisp tinted (Config.Effects style row).

Pocket.Note: The default gust in the ball's colour.
